description: Territoires administratifs des casernes is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Ensemble décrivant les territoires administratifs des casernes sur l'ensemble de l'île de Montréal. L'ensemble de données des Casernes des pompiers sur l’île de Montréal fournit la localisation des casernes. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Caserne, Incendie, Intervention, Pompier, SIM. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2025-02-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
